title: Cr-enhanced selective dealloying and sequential electrochemical reconstruction to tailor NiFe-based integrated catalysts for industrial-level water oxidation
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,8697-8707
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE03448E, Paper
Weiwei Zhang, Xiran He, Peiyao Pan, Jiantao Wang, Lu Liu, Long Hou, Xue Fan, Xionggang Lu, Xing Yu, Xi Li
Sequential electrochemical etching enables Cr-enhanced selective dealloying and surface reconstruction, allowing precise tailoring of integrated NiFe–OOH@Ni/Fe–Cr2O3@NiFeCr catalysts (NiFeCr–aee/bee) for industrial-level water oxidation.
